times.texto: Makes the team happen from the inside. Takes care of internal events, engagement and the onboarding, development and offboarding of volunteers.
Makes sure every resource generates impact. Organizes, tracks and manages the financial resources that sustain our initiatives.
Connects what we plan with what happens in practice. Supports and trains the Regional Directorates, and handles processes, contracts and paperwork with schools and education secretariats.
Turns knowledge into transformative experiences. Creates, adapts and evaluates teaching materials and strategies to boost students’ learning.
Gives Tocando em Frente a voice, a face and reach. Takes care of our communication, identity and presence to connect TEF with more people.
Always on the move. They rotate through different teams in cycles, get to know TEF as a whole and help wherever they are needed most.

Turns ideas into experiences for students. Creates the lesson plans of the six Talent Directorates: Arts & Journalism, Research & Olympiads, English & Exchange, Debates & UN Simulations, Programming & Robotics and Social Impact.
It is how the project comes to life in schools. Volunteers trained in our curriculum who build partnerships with public schools, run the activities and make the project happen on the ground.
